mathematical_engine: conditional response to forced-deleveraging intensity using event-time liquidation notional/side states
mechanism_statement: Liquidated traders are forced counterparties. Exchange liquidation engines create non-discretionary order flow that may temporarily overwhelm or exhaust available liquidity, producing continuation or reversal conditional on pressure and market absorption.
expected_sign_or_payoff_shape: unknown ex ante; the lab must permit either continuation or reversal and freeze the event-state definition before opening forward prices
failure_mode: exchange liquidation feed is incomplete/aggregated, timestamps are unsuitable, market absorbs flow immediately, or apparent signal is contemporaneous rather than predictive
regime_dependency: expected sensitivity to leverage, liquidity, volatility and open-interest regimes; no regime filter is authorized at the source-feasibility stage

source_authority.canonical_source: Tardis normalized Binance USDT Futures liquidation dataset sourced from exchange-native forceOrder feed, subject to documented snapshot limitation
source_authority.point_in_time_requirement: event timestamp and local receipt timestamp must be preserved; no liquidation inference from price/volume proxies
source_authority.coverage_gate: source-only free-sample probe must prove 2021-2024 BTCUSDT liquidation rows and required fields before any full-history source contract or outcome work

execution_assumptions.entry_exit: NOT_APPLICABLE until a separate pre-discovery authority freezes event clustering, horizon and execution assumptions

validation_path: source feasibility -> full historical acquisition -> event census -> completeness/aggregation audit -> pre-discovery freeze -> one Discovery -> independent replication/holdout
promotion_policy_reference: fail-closed lab governance; no performance opening before source and sample gates
nearest_existing_family_or_lab: DEFI-LIQUIDATION-SHOCK-001 and prior LIQUIDATION-PRESSURE-001 official/free-source feasibility closeout
material_difference_from_existing_work: uses a directly observed historical centralized-exchange liquidation feed rather than inferring liquidations from price/volume/open-interest proxies or on-chain lending events
